newsitem.title: USA: Amex S&P 500 receipt trust SPY hits $1.4 billion.
newsitem.headline: Amex S&P 500 receipt trust SPY hits $1.4 billion.

text.p: American Stock Exchange said the trust for its Standard & Poor's Depositary Receipts, or SPDRs, grew to $1.4 billion at the end of the third quarter, up from $1 billion at the beginning of 1996.
Average daily volume in the quarter for the SPDRs, which trade at one-tenth the value of the S&P 500 .SPX, grew 185 percent over same period a year ago, to 920,529 receipts.

Average daily volume has steadily increased since SPDRs were introduced in 1993, Jay Baker, managing director at the exchange said. "But 1996 is definitely shaping up as the year to beat in terms of SPDRs volume," Baker said.
